meta.task_name: Environment-based OpenAI API key loading + README instructions

notes.note: Phase-3 schema exists as Pydantic models with strict extra="forbid".
CodeSpecArtifact currently has openai_integration but no runtime_configuration/readme_requirements fields.
Global hard rules and phase-specific rules/checklists exist, but do not mention env key loading or README requirements.
Prompt builder uses schema_excerpt_json(openai_compatible_schema(...)) and “Return JSON only” anti-drift constraints.

objective.summary: Update the phase-3 CodeSpec schema and prompting rules so every generated CodeSpec explicitly requires: (1) reading OPENAI_API_KEY from environment (via an env file), (2) shipping an .env.example (or equivalent), (3) failing fast with a clear UI error message when missing, (4) README setup steps for env file placement and local run.

field.name: env_var_name
field.description: Environment variable name required for OpenAI auth (must be OPENAI_API_KEY).

field.name: env_file_name
field.description: Name/location convention for the env file used in local runs (e.g., ".env").

field.name: env_example_file
field.description: Required example env file committed to repo (must be ".env.example" or equivalent).

field.name: env_example_required
field.description: Must be true: repo includes an env example file.

field.name: load_strategy
field.description: Concrete runtime approach for loading env vars (e.g., platform env first; then load from env_file_name in local dev; never hardcode secrets; never commit real keys).

field.name: missing_key_fail_fast_behavior
field.description: Must specify fail-fast behavior with a clear UI-visible error state/message when OPENAI_API_KEY is missing. Include what the UI shows and how the app prevents further AI calls until fixed.

field.name: setup_steps
field.description: Exact step-by-step setup instructions (including creating/copying env file and adding OPENAI_API_KEY).

field.name: env_file_instructions
field.description: Exact instructions: where to place the env file, what to name it, and how to fill it.

field.name: local_run_instructions
field.description: Exact local run commands/steps (as text) appropriate to the demo’s stack constraints.

field.name: troubleshooting
field.description: Troubleshooting bullets including missing-key symptom and resolution, and any common env-loading gotchas.

add_required_field.name: runtime_configuration
add_required_field.description: Required runtime configuration contract for env-based OpenAI key loading.

add_required_field.name: readme_requirements
add_required_field.description: Required README content contract for setup and local run.

notes.note: Ensure new fields are required (no default, no Optional).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CodeSpecArtifact JSON schema includes runtime_configuration and readme_requirements as required properties.
runtime_configuration enforces OPENAI_API_KEY via Literal and requires env example file + fail-fast UI behavior.
Schema remains compatible with strict structured outputs (additionalProperties:false, required includes all properties).

step.title: Update phase-3 prompting rules to enforce G1 requirements

update_global_hard_rules.add_rule: Every demo must load OPENAI_API_KEY from environment (via an env file for local dev), include an .env.example, and fail fast with a clear UI error message when the key is missing.
CodeSpec must include explicit README setup steps: env file placement/naming, how to set OPENAI_API_KEY, and how to run locally.

update_phase_rules.add_rule: Specify runtime configuration: where env vars come from, env file convention, .env.example requirement, and fail-fast UI error state.
Include README requirements with exact setup + local run steps and troubleshooting for missing OPENAI_API_KEY.

update_phase_priority_checklist.add_item: Include runtime_configuration requiring OPENAI_API_KEY via env + .env.example + UI fail-fast missing-key behavior.
Include readme_requirements with explicit env file setup steps and local run instructions.

notes.note: Do not add prose outside JSON; keep “Return JSON only” constraints.
Keep scope limited to spec generation; do not implement app runtime code here.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase-3 developer prompt includes explicit G1 rules as hard constraints.
Phase-3 user prompt checklist includes G1 items so the model reliably populates the new schema fields.

verify.item: Confirm openai_compatible_schema() still produces valid strict JSON schema after adding nested objects: - additionalProperties:false on all object nodes - required includes all properties everywhere - $ref has no sibling keywords

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No schema transformation regressions; structured-output call remains strict-compatible.

checks.check: Generated CodeSpec always contains runtime_configuration requiring OPENAI_API_KEY, an env file convention, and .env.example requirement.
Generated CodeSpec always contains readme_requirements with exact setup + run steps and troubleshooting.
Prompts enforce missing-key fail-fast UI behavior as a requirement (not optional).
